name: Ambergrid Room-Temperature Superconductor
summary: Made-up sample problem. Ambergrid lattices are a fictional family of layered crystals that theory suggests might superconduct, carrying current with no resistance, at room temperature. This is an open-ended materials goal rather than a single question: progress is measured by how warm a confirmed ambergrid superconductor can get at normal pressure. The best confirmed crystal superconducts only below about -190 °C, and a 2024 claim of superconductivity near room temperature could not be reproduced.

progress.title: Ambergrid family proposed from theory
progress.description: Calculations suggested that electrons in some ambergrid lattices could stay paired, and so superconduct, at much higher temperatures than usual.

progress.title: First ambergrid crystals grown and tested
progress.description: Small crystals were grown for the first time. They superconduct, but only below about -230 °C.

progress.title: Squeezing crystals to raise the temperature
progress.description: High pressure raised the superconducting temperature by only a few degrees before the layers broke apart. Pressure also works against the goal, which is a material that superconducts at normal pressure. Do not retry without a new way to keep the layers intact.

progress.title: AI-assisted search through 40,000 variants
progress.description: An AI model ranked about 40,000 possible ambergrid variants by how likely they are to superconduct at higher temperatures. The lab made and tested the twelve best candidates. The best of them superconducts below about -190 °C, the confirmed record for the family.

progress.title: Claimed superconductivity at 18 °C in variant AG-7
progress.description: A team reported zero resistance up to 18 °C in a variant called AG-7. Two other teams made AG-7 and saw no superconductivity. The sudden drop in resistance may come from an impurity in the original samples. The claim has been neither confirmed nor withdrawn.

progress.title: Blind re-test of AG-7 with purer samples
progress.description: Four labs are growing purer AG-7 crystals and measuring them blind, with one shared written method. An AI agent checks the raw data for common measurement errors, such as poor electrical contacts.

progress.title: Room-temperature superconductor confirmed at normal pressure
progress.description: Make an ambergrid material that superconducts at room temperature and normal pressure, and have at least two independent labs reproduce it. Even then, turning it into practical wires and cables would be further work.
